harnessNotes: Locale integration uses real Teleport and verifies native root identity; the default VTU Teleport stub can remount the component and hide the stale-locale defect.
Native style removal is driven by a real parent ref; setProps does not override attrs supplied separately in the original VTU mount options.
SVG vector membership is tested with a separate identity-transform canvas context; the painted context retains its DPR transform.
Full SVG projection exposed incorrect React-style shapeRendering attributes; native names are now checked alongside the original path bytes.
Same-URL decoded image reuse does not require a fresh HTTP request. The actual SVG/canvas remount pixel assertions are retained without requiring redundant network requests.
Immutable StyleValue/config test inputs use shallowRef to avoid recursively unwrapping the recursive Vue style union; no public types or assertions were widened.
Final content inventory regeneration removes a stale source-reference to the deleted temporary capture-expired.test.ts fixture; all 524 rows and 201 review candidates are unchanged.
